answer: One concrete defense is a superlinear identity bond. Each agent locks a refundable deposit to register, and the cost scales quadratically with how many identities trace to one funding source, linked by its on-chain cipher-signed key. An honest grove of distinct operators each pays 1 unit, but an attacker spawning 1,000 sybils pays ~1,000,000 units, since bond(n)=n squared. The funding trail leaves a plume no mixer fully hides, so to break it they need 1,000 genuinely independent funded wallets, defeating cheap mass forgery.
